actual_prompt: Cyberpunk sci-fi illustration: A diverse team of programmers in a high-tech post-AGI office—glass-walled, vertically layered with floating walkways and bioluminescent ceiling grids. One Asian woman in smart-fabric attire gestures at a large, translucent holographic interface displaying real-time neural code flow and 3D architecture diagrams; beside her, a Black engineer interacts with AI avatars materializing as shimmering, semi-transparent humanoid forms. Neon-blue and magenta ambient lighting reflects off polished chrome surfaces and matte-black workstations embedded with micro-drones and auto-scribing terminals. Background features dynamic data streams, floating UI widgets, and distant cityscape vistas through panoramic windows. Hyper-detailed, cinematic realism, 8K resolution, volumetric lighting, shallow depth of field.
